meta.notes: Story-mode steps; bodies are templated at export time from the exported numbers. Selectors are data-story attributes the screens must render: mission-hero, parts-hotspot-32, forecast-demand-strip, rotable-float-calc, network-bom, frontier-chart, aog-incident-ps1, action-inbox.

steps.title: Fewer groundings, at a stated price
steps.body: On 20 holdout seeds the recommended plan (I125) cuts modelled material AOG from 2,871 to 223 hours a year and lifts immediate fill from 95.4% to 98.1%, for AED 5.0 M more spare capital than the legacy P0 rules.

steps.title: A brake that is never at BOM
steps.body: GN-32-R014, a carbon brake assembly (ATA 32, D0), had 16 D0 requests at BOM in two years of history and 16 AOG events there (144 h) because P0 held 0 units at BOM. Its risk score is 89/100; ATA 32 has 3 urgent PNs.

steps.title: Why brake demand is intermittent
steps.body: The brake's weekly demand is intermittent (ADI 1.69 weeks, CV² 0.35 on training weeks 0–77). For intermittent rotables the frozen MASE champion 'naive' ranked 9/9 on the holdout, so the policies size rotables on the reliability-exposure rate instead.

steps.title: Float maths for one rotable
steps.body: Network removals run at 3.5 per 30 days with a 35-day hub pipeline. P0 holds 5 serviceable units, P2 16, the recommended plan 18. Even on its own 40-day repair loop, Palm's theorem gives 79% availability for the 2 units P2 places at BOM.

steps.title: Positioning beats reacting
steps.body: At BOM, holdout material AOG falls from 291 h/yr under P0 to 40 under P2, which stocks outstations where the D0 penalty pays for the unit. Each emergency hop from AUH takes 9 h.

steps.title: Where to stop buying
steps.body: The pre-stated rule walks the capital-vs-AOG hull until an extra AED 1 M saves fewer than 9.4 AOG h/yr, and stops at I125: AED 41.9 M capital and 223 AOG h/yr on the holdout, against 533 h for P2 at AED 37.0 M.

steps.title: One incident, replayed
steps.body: AOG-0001: A6-FHU grounded at BOM for 9 h waiting for a brake. The desk's options, ranked on information available then, put the AUH emergency transfer first (Emergency transfer from AUH).

steps.title: What the planner does on Monday
steps.body: The action centre raises 75 exceptions for week 103, 28 urgent - including 'GN-32-R014 at BOM: 0 serviceable (+0 inbound) vs target 2 (demand-implied protection level); 7 D0 requests and 63 AOG h in 52 weeks'.
